meta.title: Biocalibration + 10-20 Harvest Overlap Audit
meta.purpose: Prevent duplicate competencies from being added to the active D2 bank and identify candidates that should replace or strengthen existing questions instead.

findings.finding: Both items test calculation of the first 10% interval from a preauricular-to-preauricular head measurement.
findings.action: Do not activate as an additional question. Replace the harvest item with a different measurement-workflow competency before merge.

findings.finding: Both items identify sweat artifact as slow low-frequency or rolling baseline drift.
findings.action: Do not add as a separate basic item. Use the new source to improve the existing question/rationale or create a more advanced correction scenario.

findings.finding: Both test recognition of contamination caused by a shared reference electrode. The harvest item is more specific because it uses C3-M2 and O1-M2 and asks the learner to localize the M2 problem.
findings.action: Consider the harvest item as an upgrade/replacement rather than an additive question.

findings.finding: Both involve high-frequency muscle activity, but the harvest item anchors the artifact to a known jaw-clench biocalibration maneuver and therefore tests applied interpretation rather than generic recognition.
findings.action: Keep as a distinct applied candidate if the final bank needs calibration-based troubleshooting.

findings.finding: The item depends on a numerical impedance target stated in a 2016 source.
findings.action: Blocked until current AASM technical specifications are verified.

findings.finding: The item is tied to a legacy description of the PSG EEG montage and minimum regional sampling.
findings.action: Blocked until current AASM technical requirements and BRPT alignment are verified.
